title: VALUE DRIFTS: TRACING VALUE ALIGNMENT DUR-ING LLM POST-TRAINING
findings: The paper found that for the topic of 'Religion and Spirituality Beliefs', the Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) stage is the primary driver of the model's stance, with the specific SFT dataset (WildChat vs. Alpaca) determining the final value profile. For instance, training Llama3 on WildChat increased its neutral stance towards religion, while training on Alpaca slightly increased its supportive stance. Subsequent preference optimization stages (PPO, DPO, SimPO) using standard datasets were found to induce minimal to no further changes, largely preserving the values established during SFT.
